newsitem.title: UK: Allied Colloids sees stg hurting profits.
newsitem.headline: Allied Colloids sees stg hurting profits.

text.p: British industrial chemicals firm Allied Colloids Group Plc said on Wednesday it expected to have another good year in 1997/98, but it added that sterling's strength would hurt profits.
The company's pre-tax profits rose 30 percent to 54.6 million stg for the year ended on March 31.
Allied said that recent exchange rates would have hurt last year's profitability by about 5.0 million stg had they applied throughout 1996/97.

"Our paper, mining and pollution control divisions, which represent two-thirds of our business, continue to grow strongly, although for the remainder we expect more modest growth," chief executive David Farrar said in the company's earnings statement.
"Overall, I believe significant progress was made in 1996/97 and expect Allied Colloids to have another good year in 1997-98," he added.
